summary: HUTCHMED filed a 6-K disclosing an AIM Rule 17 Schedule 2(g) update: Chairman Dr Dan Eldar was formerly a director of S.D. Sight Diagnostics Ltd., which entered Israeli insolvency proceedings. The filing clarifies neither S.D. Sight nor Hutchison Water Israel E.P.C Ltd is part of the Group, and the proceedings involve about US$1.02 million. The board deems no impact on its business. This is a routine compliance disclosure, not a corporate special situation. No deal terms or strategic actions are involved. What to watch: no action required; purely informational.
